# ChatUtils by D4KiR

## [v0.5.1](https://github.com/d4kir92/chatutils/tree/v0.5.1) (2026-11-20)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/d4kir92/chatutils/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/d4kir92/chatutils/releases)

- v0.5.1  
- Fix player level detection for group and /who on Forever  
    - Group and raid members' level now shows in chat on Forever  
    - Levels from /who results are picked up more reliably  
    - Group levels update when members level up

# ChatUtils by D4KiR

## [v0.5.0](https://github.com/d4kir92/chatutils/tree/v0.5.0) (2026-11-20)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/d4kir92/chatutils/compare/v0.4.23...v0.5.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/d4kir92/chatutils/releases)

- v0.5.0  
- Add settings sidebar, What's New and reorganize categories  
    - Settings window has a category sidebar  
    - New What's New window shows newly added settings  
    - Settings regrouped into Chat Window, Character and Items & Money  
- Add per-message chat fade option  
    - New option to fade out chat messages one by one  
    - Adjustable fade time (5-600 seconds, default 60)  
- Fix guild member level missing in chat  
    - Guild member levels are now found by character ID, so they show in chat on Forever
